summary: Overall 2-page sheet geometry matches 1706 Jan 2018 ENCS; targeted fixes needed for long name overflow in Item 7A, Page 2 Taxpayer/Buyer Name comb alignment, Schedule 1 classification/alignment/padding, Schedule 2 Item 6 integer formatting and Item 7 installment date, and screen field labels/kinds.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 7A (Buyer's Name) and Item 6A (Seller's Name)
defects.what: Long Buyer's Name overflows its right cell border and collides with Buyer's Registered Address; cells lack overflow clipping and horizontal padding.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Items 6A and 7A (Registered Address)
defects.what: Address text sits flush against the left vertical border with no inner padding.

defects.where: Page 2, header Taxpayer's/Buyer's Name comb box
defects.what: Name prints as plain proportional text crossing the vertical comb ticks instead of one character per comb slot.
Classification column prints blank even when a classification (e.g. Residential) is selected.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 table cells (OCT/TCT/CCT No., TD No., Location, Area, FMV columns, TOTAL)
defects.what: Currency amounts in FMV and TOTAL columns are left-aligned flush against left borders instead of right-aligned with padding; text cells lack inner padding.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 2 Item 6 (No. of Installments in the contract)
defects.what: Displays '12.00' as plain text crossing the comb tick instead of an integer placed into the two comb slots.
Date of Installment comb prints blank even when installment date components are populated.

defects.where: Part IV, Schedule 2 Item 6 (No. of Installments in the contract)
defects.what: Rendered as decimal money ('12.00') instead of an integer count ('12').
Shortened labels 'TCT' and 'Area' diverge from official form captions 'OCT/TCT/CCT No.' and 'Area (sq.m.)'.

defects.where: Part I Items 7A (Buyer's Name, Buyer's Registered Address) and Schedule 1 Location
defects.what: Single-line text inputs are narrow (~240px) inside the card so long names and addresses clip horizontally.

shared_changes_wanted: nsh/screens/form/: widen long single-line text inputs (names, addresses, locations) to use available card width instead of clipping at ~240px.
